quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #23
										  					
  

33 Questions • Passing Score 27

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, what should you do?

options.text: Turn the wheel sharply in the opposite direction.
Turn your steering wheel toward oncoming traffic.
Turn your steering wheel in the direction the vehicle is skidding.
Let go of the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel in the direction the vehicle is skidding.
questions.explanation: Stay calm if your vehicle skids. Steer the wheel in the direction the vehicle is moving.

questions.question: In bad weather, drivers should:

options.text: Drive faster to get where they are going sooner.
Follow the car ahead more closely.
Stay farther away from the car ahead.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther away from the car ahead.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, increase the distance between you and the car ahead.

questions.question: Turn signals must be visible from how far away?

options.text: 500 feet.
250 feet.
300 feet.
Only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: 300 feet.
questions.explanation: Turn signals must be visible from 300 feet away in sunlight.

questions.question: Stopping distance does NOT depend on:

options.text: How fast you can react.
What time of day it is.
Whether your brakes work well.
What type of tires you have.

questions.correctAnswerText: What time of day it is.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, your vehicle's weight, brake condition, tire condition, road conditions, and speed. The time of day does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone ahead.
School crossing.
Pedestrians may cross here.
Construction workers are working nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians may cross here.
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with a black symbol. It tells drivers that people may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: The light is green, but traffic coming toward you is heavy and you want to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Use a different intersection.
Wait at the edge of the road for traffic to clear.
Move into the intersection and wait for traffic to clear.
Turn now because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move into the intersection and wait for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: If the light is green and the path is clear, you can enter the intersection. Wait there for oncoming traffic to pass before you turn left.

questions.question: When you turn left onto a one-way street, which lane should you turn into?

options.text: The right lane.
The lane closest to where you came from.
Any lane.
No lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to where you came from.
questions.explanation: Always turn into the lane that is closest to the lane you just left.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with no warning signals?

options.text: Always stop completely.
Slow down and get ready to stop if needed.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this never happens.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and get ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with no signals, slow down and look both ways. Stop if you see or hear a train. Wait until the train passes before you cross.

questions.question: A single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving the same direction. A broken line means you can pass when it is safe.

questions.question: When entering a freeway, what should you do?

options.text: Go slowly while looking for an opening.
Speed up faster than freeway traffic.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to speed up to match freeway traffic so you can merge smoothly and safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: No passing zone.
Winding road.
Pedestrian crossing.
Low ground railroad crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low ground railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle on a two-lane road with traffic moving in opposite directions, what should you do?

options.text: Return to your lane when there is enough space between you and the vehicle you passed.
Stay in the left lane if you plan to turn left.
Return to the right side of the road right away.
Drive in either lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Return to your lane when there is enough space between you and the vehicle you passed.
questions.explanation: When passing on a two-lane road, return to the right side as soon as there is enough space between you and the car you passed.

questions.question: If two vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The larger vehicle.
The car on the left.
The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: At an uncontrolled intersection, if two cars arrive at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The left driver can then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
U-turns are not allowed.
You may go if the way is clear.
You must come to a complete stop before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does a solid white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means drivers cannot pass.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from the side with the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the side with the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the side with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means passing is allowed only from the lane with the broken line.

questions.question: When can you cross solid yellow lines?

options.text: To pass traffic moving in the same direction.
During the day only.
At any time.
When you are turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are turning.
questions.explanation: Generally, you cannot cross solid lines. You can cross a solid yellow line only when turning.

questions.question: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle coming, what should you do?

options.text: Stop right away and let the vehicle pass.
Move to the right side of the road as safely as you can and stop.
Drive slowly and let the vehicle pass.
Keep moving slowly on the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right side of the road as safely as you can and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle with lights or siren, move as far right as safely possible and stop. Do not stop in an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop sign ahead.
Lane closed ahead.
Railroad crossing ahead.
Traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?

options.text: Turning left.
Turning right.
Coming to a stop.
Going straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning right.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are behind this driver.

questions.question: What is the correct way to use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before you enter the exit ramp.
Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same once you are on the exit ramp.
Pass slower cars on the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down until you move onto the exit ramp.

questions.question: What do pentagonal signs mean?

options.text: No passing zones.
School zones.
Speed limits.
Railroad crossings.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zones.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs show that you are in a school zone. Watch carefully for children and pedestrians near schools.

questions.question: When the road has a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line next to your lane, when may you pass?

options.text: Only in an emergency.
Only on an expressway.
When the road ahead is clear.
Only at an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: When the road ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: You may pass if the broken line is next to your lane and there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When you drive past a car that just parked on the side of the road, what should you do?

options.text: Expect that the driver may open the door as you pass.
Speed up.
Brake hard.
Expect that the driver will wait for you to pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Expect that the driver may open the door as you pass.
questions.explanation: When passing a parked car, be ready for the driver to open the door. Drive with extra caution near parked vehicles.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway and children are playing nearby. What should you do first?

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Honk your horn so children will hear you.
Walk behind the car to check that the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk behind the car to check that the way is clear.
questions.explanation: Get out of your car and check behind it before backing up. Do not rely only on your mirrors, especially when children are nearby.

questions.question: What lights should you use when driving in fog?

options.text: Parking lights.
Low beam headlights.
High beam headlights.
It does not matter which lights you use.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: What color are signs for public recreation areas?

options.text: Orange.
Red.
Green.
Brown.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brown.
questions.explanation: Brown signs show public recreation areas and places of cultural or historical importance. They help you find attractions when you travel.

questions.question: What should you adjust first when you get into a car to drive?

options.text: Your seat belt.
The steering wheel.
Your rearview mirror.
Your seat.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your seat.
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat first so you are comfortable and can see the road. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: What is used on some highways to show drivers which lane to use for turning?

options.text: Flashing red lights.
Flashing yellow lights.
White lines on the side of the road.
White arrows painted in the lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows painted in the lanes.
questions.explanation: Arrows show which lanes to use for turning or driving straight.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: A no passing zone.
A one-way traffic area.
The blind spot around a large truck.
An area for motor vehicles only.

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot around a large truck.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are the large blind spots around trucks and big vehicles. Avoid staying in these spots.

questions.question: When there are two railroad tracks next to each other, what should you do?

options.text: It is always safe to cross after one train passes.
You must always stop before crossing the tracks.
After one train passes, check the other track for another train before you cross.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: After one train passes, check the other track for another train before you cross.
questions.explanation: With two railroad tracks next to each other, a second train may be coming on the other track. Wait until you are sure no train is coming from any direction on either track before you cross.

questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights so other drivers will let you through.
Drive around the back of a car that is blocking you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before you turn. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If another car hits you from behind, straight wheels keep you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The divided highway is ending.
One-way traffic is ahead.
Two-way traffic is ahead.
Stay to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.
